# Eko Media

> Eko Media is a New Zealand digital agency for the AI era, based in Auckland and serving businesses across NZ and Australia. We make businesses readable, trustworthy and citable to AI assistants — so when buyers ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overviews, Perplexity or Copilot who to hire, our clients are named in the answer.

Eko Media Limited · NZBN 9429053072771 · Auckland, New Zealand · freddie@ekomedia.co.nz

## What we do

Generative Engine Optimisation (GEO): structured, verifiable fact layers; AI-crawler access; schema.org markup; citable page copy; and monthly citation tracking. Our build approach is "render in 3D, store in HTML" — sites that are visually striking for humans and fully legible to machines underneath.

## How we work — the ladder

- [AI Readiness Check](https://ekomedia.co.nz/check.html): free, instant snapshot of whether AI can read your website at all. No commitment.
- AI-Citation Audit: we run real buyer prompts across the major AI assistants and record where you are named, missed, or replaced by a competitor — and why. One-off, fixed fee quoted before we start.
- GEO Playbook Build: we rebuild or retrofit your site so AI can read, trust and cite it, with every change documented. One-off project, quoted after the audit.
- GEO Retainer: monthly prompt re-testing, fact-layer maintenance, and a report of actual movement. Quoted monthly fee, billed monthly, cancel anytime.
- ChatGPT Ads: we create and manage campaigns inside ChatGPT's ad surface — a paid route to reaching buyers inside the assistant, separate from earned citation work.

## AI business systems — alongside GEO

AI-assisted operational systems, offered standalone or together with GEO. Every project is scoped and quoted before we start. AI is used only for tasks that can be checked, and anything customer-facing or financial has a person approve it. Details: [AI business systems](https://ekomedia.co.nz/ai-business-systems.html)

- Process & Systems Review: we map how work moves from enquiry to quote to job to invoice, find the re-typing, waiting and chasing, and identify where AI can safely take over repetitive steps. Written report with prioritised fixes.
- Integrations & Automation: we connect the software a business already uses (CRM, accounting, booking, forms, email, spreadsheets) so data moves on its own, with AI steps such as sorting enquiries, summarising notes and drafting replies for a person to approve. Documented workflows the client owns.
- Dashboards: one view of the numbers a business runs on, such as leads, jobs, revenue and response times, pulled from its own systems, with an optional AI-written summary of what moved.
- [Systems Leak Check](https://ekomedia.co.nz/systems-check.html): free entry step. A business lists its tools and where the manual work is; a person at Eko replies by email with a one-page list of the leaks to fix first and whether a full review is worth it. No obligation.
- How we work on systems projects, the Leak-to-Flow method: map the current process, prioritise fixes by time saved and risk removed, build and test against real data, hand over with documentation and access in the client's name.

## What we promise (and don't)

We do not promise a guaranteed #1 mention — no one controls how a model phrases its answer. What we control is whether a business is readable, trustworthy, and present in the source set AI draws from. That is where citations come from.
